description: This header file declares the updateHandler class and associated functions for managing TR-069 host interface update events within the project. It specifically provides function prototypes, includes necessary external dependencies, and defines callback types relevant to the host interface updates.

classes.name: updateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling update events related to the TR-069 host interface. It includes static methods for initialization, stopping, resetting, running in a thread, and sending notifications via callbacks.

methods.name: updateHandler::Init
methods.description: Initializes the update handler, preparing it to manage update events.

methods.name: updateHandler::stop
methods.description: Stops the update handler, terminating any ongoing activities.

methods.name: updateHandler::reset
methods.description: Resets the state of the update handler to its initial state.

methods.name: updateHandler::run
methods.description: Runs the handler in a separate thread context, processing update events.

methods.name: updateHandler::notifyCallback
methods.description: Invokes registered callback functions with specific event information.

methods.name: sendAddRemoveEvents
methods.description: Function to send add/remove events, invoking callback functions with updated parameters.
